summary: No exploitable insolvency vectors found. The protocol's reserve accounting is sound: all token inflows verified by strict balance checks, all fee credits backed by actual token balances, rounding consistently favors the protocol, and reentrancy protection (ENTERED bit + CEI pattern) prevents double-spend. 14 attack vectors thoroughly investigated and ruled out with evidence. The codebase is well-hardened against fund extraction at the reserve/accounting layer.
